_comment: Curated map: advisory id or alias -> vulnerable callable and severity. Add an entry only after reading the advisory and the fix commit. Unmapped advisories are still scored (conservatively) as reachable with no runtime data.

GHSA-gmj6-6f8f-6699._evidence: CVE-2024-56201, fixed in 3.1.5 by pallets/jinja@767b236 (escape template name in the f-string built in visit_FromImport). Reached through dynamic visit_<Node> dispatch, which static analysis cannot follow; runtime hits are the check.

GHSA-q2x7-8rv6-6q7h._evidence: CVE-2024-56326, fixed in 3.1.5 by pallets/jinja@48b0687 (sandbox indirect calls to str.format). Only SandboxedEnvironment.

GHSA-cpwx-vrp4-4pq7._evidence: CVE-2025-27516, fixed in 3.1.6 by pallets/jinja@90457bb (attr filter uses env.getattr). Only templates using |attr.
